notes: No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The Elections Department page lists unofficial and official files per election (some on newtools.cira.state.tx.us, the same CMS file host). 2024 general: 'UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 11-5-24 GENERAL ELECTION-RAINS CO' is a scanned Cumulative Results Report (county totals, 'Polling Places Reporting 10 of 11', run time read as about 9:13 PM 11/5/2024), scan created 9:38 PM CST, Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 17:00:25 GMT (11:00 AM CST Nov 6); then 'Rains County Official Results November 5 2024' (not opened). 2026 primary: 'UNOFFICIAL 2026 PRIMARY ELECTION RESULTS' is a scanned cumulative report (county totals, 37 pages), Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 14:13:35 GMT (8:13 AM CST Mar 4); 'UNOFFICIAL PRECINCT BY PRECINCT RESULTS' is a Precinct Results Report 'Unofficial Results', Run Time 8:19 PM Run Date 03/04/2026 ('Polling Places Reporting 10 of 11'), Last-Modified Mon, 06 Apr 2026 13:45:08 GMT. 2026 runoff: 'UNOFFICIAL RESULTS PRIMARY RUN-OFF 5-26-26' is a scanned Cumulative Results Report (county totals), scan created 9:05 PM CDT, Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 02:09:01 GMT (9:09 PM CDT May 26); no unofficial precinct report is listed for the runoff, only 'Official Cumulative Results-6-2-2026'. Confidence low: only the runoff has both printed and upload times on election night. Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-2): 2024_general LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2024-11-05 21:38 CT; 2026_primary LATER to UNDETERMINED. 2026_primary: the county-totals file was scanned Mar 4 13:48 UTC (7:48 AM CST) and its OCR text shows no run time.
tag_rationale: Results: 2024_general LATER, 2026_primary UNDETERMINED, 2026_runoff LATER. Two or more elections share the result that maps to COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS, so the rule gives COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS. (Recomputed under Rule 43, 2026-10-02.)
